Lisa · Listen & Shadow 06

Interpreting at the Cellar Door — before, Craggy Range, Rapaura Springs, in the winery
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · BEFORE THEY ARRIVE
👤 The Winery
What do you want to know about each winery before you walk in?
들어가기 전에 뭘 알고 싶어요?
walk in — 들어가다
💬 Lisa
I'd want to know who's going to be in the room before I go in.
들어가기 전에 누가 자리에 있는지는 알고 싶어요.
in the room — 그 자리에 · before I go in — 들어가기 전에
같은 패턴으로 — I'd want to know the schedule before I commit. · I'd want to know the numbers before the call.
💬 Lisa
I know less about the Marlborough side.
라파우라 쪽은 제가 잘 몰라요.
know less about ~ — ~는 잘 모르다
같은 패턴으로 — I know less about the reds. · I know less about that region than I'd like.
💬 Lisa
The night before, I'd read up on the soils and the varieties.
전날 밤엔 토양이랑 품종부터 찾아볼 거예요.
read up on ~ — ~를 미리 찾아보다 · variety — 품종
같은 패턴으로 — The night before, I'd go through the tasting notes. · I'd read up on the family history.
💬 Lisa
What I'd hate is getting stuck on a technical word.
제일 곤란한 건 전문용어에서 막히는 거예요.
get stuck on ~ — ~에서 막히다
같은 패턴으로 — What I'd hate is freezing mid-sentence. · What I'd hate is guessing wrong.
💬 Lisa
I'd rather over-prepare than walk in cold.
차라리 과하게 준비하는 게 나아요.
over-prepare — 과하게 준비하다 · walk in cold — 준비 없이 들어가다
같은 패턴으로 — I'd rather over-prepare than wing it. · I'd rather ask twice than guess.
PART 2 · CRAGGY RANGE
👤 The Winery
What kind of soil is Gimblett Gravels, and why does it matter?
김블렛 그래블이 뭐고 왜 중요하죠?
soil — 토양
💬 Lisa
The Gimblett Gravels is a defined vineyard district in Hawke's Bay — about 800 hectares.
김블렛 그래블은 호크스베이 안의 포도밭 지구예요 — 약 800헥타르요.
vineyard district — 포도밭 지구 · hectare — 헥타르
같은 패턴으로 — It's a defined region, not a brand. · It's a district about the size of a small town.
💬 Lisa
A flood in 1876 changed the river's course and exposed the gravel.
1876년 홍수로 강이 물길을 바꾸면서 자갈밭이 드러났어요.
flood — 홍수 · course — 물길 · expose — 드러내다
같은 패턴으로 — A storm changed the coastline there. · The fire exposed the old foundations.
💬 Lisa
It was too poor to farm — it was nearly sold as a quarry.
농사가 안 되는 땅이라 채석장이 될 뻔했어요.
too poor to farm — 농사짓기엔 너무 척박한 · quarry — 채석장
같은 패턴으로 — It was too steep to plant. · The land was nearly sold off.
💬 Lisa
The gravel holds the day's heat and releases it at night.
자갈이 낮에 열을 머금었다가 밤에 내놓아요.
hold heat — 열을 머금다 · release — 내놓다
같은 패턴으로 — Stone holds the heat longer than soil. · The wall releases warmth after sunset.
💬 Lisa
That's why Bordeaux varieties and Syrah ripen there.
그래서 보르도 품종과 시라가 거기서 익어요.
ripen — 익다
같은 패턴으로 — That's why Pinot does well further south. · That's why the harvest is later there.
💬 Lisa
They have three sites — Gimblett, Te Muna, and Giants Estate.
세 곳이 있어요 — 김블렛, 테 무나, 자이언츠 이스테이트.
site — 밭, 부지
같은 패턴으로 — They have two cellars and one tasting room. · We carry three labels from them.
PART 3 · RAPAURA SPRINGS
👤 The Winery
Where does the water come from, and why does that make a difference?
물은 어디서 오고, 그게 왜 차이를 만들죠?
make a difference — 차이를 만들다
💬 Lisa
It's snowmelt from the Southern Alps, running down the Wairau.
서던 알프스에서 녹은 눈이 와이라우 강을 따라 내려와요.
snowmelt — 눈 녹은 물 · run down — 따라 흐르다
같은 패턴으로 — It's runoff from the hills. · The water comes down from the ranges.
💬 Lisa
It sinks into a deep aquifer underground.
땅속으로 스며들어 대수층을 이뤄요.
sink into ~ — ~로 스며들다 · aquifer — 대수층
같은 패턴으로 — The water sinks into the gravel. · It filters down through the rock.
💬 Lisa
It surfaces as springs beside the vineyards about six months later.
6개월쯤 뒤에 밭 옆에서 샘으로 솟아요.
surface — 솟아오르다 · spring — 샘
같은 패턴으로 — It comes up as a spring behind the winery. · The stream surfaces further down the valley.
💬 Lisa
That's why they don't need to irrigate.
그래서 관개가 필요 없어요.
irrigate — 관개하다, 물을 대다
같은 패턴으로 — That's why they don't spray as much. · That's why the vines go deep.
💬 Lisa
ROHE isn't an abbreviation — it's a Māori word for region.
ROHE는 약자가 아니라 마오리어로 지역이라는 뜻이에요.
abbreviation — 약자
같은 패턴으로 — That's a place name, not a brand. · It's a word, not an acronym.
PART 4 · IN THE WINERY
👤 The Winery
We hand-pick everything here — machines would break the bunches.
전부 손수확한다고 하네요.
hand-pick — 손으로 수확하다 · bunch — 포도송이
💬 Lisa
They cut the bunches by hand instead of using a machine.
기계 대신 사람이 손으로 송이를 잘라요.
by hand — 손으로 · instead of ~ — ~ 대신
같은 패턴으로 — They do it by hand instead of by machine. · We sort by hand at the door.
💬 Lisa
It's slower and more expensive, but you can sort as you pick.
느리고 비싸지만, 따면서 골라낼 수 있어요.
sort — 골라내다
같은 패턴으로 — It's slower, but you catch the bad fruit. · It costs more, but you get better fruit.
💬 Lisa
Wild ferment means the yeast already on the grapes starts the fermentation.
야생 효모라는 건 포도에 이미 있는 효모로 발효한다는 뜻이에요.
wild ferment — 야생 발효 · yeast — 효모
같은 패턴으로 — Wild ferment means nothing is added. · Native yeast means the vineyard's own.
💬 Lisa
Malolactic fermentation turns sharp acid into softer acid.
젖산 발효는 날카로운 산을 부드럽게 바꿔요.
malolactic fermentation — 젖산 발효 · sharp — 날카로운
같은 패턴으로 — It turns the edge into something rounder. · It softens the finish.
💬 Lisa
New oak gives vanilla and spice; old oak just lets the wine breathe.
새 오크는 바닐라와 향신료를, 헌 오크는 숨 쉴 공간을 줘요.
new oak — 새 오크통 · breathe — 숨 쉬다
같은 패턴으로 — New barrels add flavour; old ones don't. · Steel gives you nothing but time.
💬 Lisa
Sorry, could you say that again? I want to get it right.
죄송한데 다시 한 번요 — 정확히 옮기고 싶어서요.
get it right — 정확히 하다
같은 패턴으로 — Sorry, one more time? · Could I check one word with you?
녹음 26/26
